understanding: A pigeon given a pellet every peck eats until full and stops; the random-pellet lane sets up the contrast.
evidence: it will eat until it's full and stop. But if you give the pigeon a pellet at random intervals
before: two lanes, each a pellet and a high pecks level
transformation: in the every-time lane the pellet drains the pecking to near zero; the random lane is left unresolved
after: top lane pecks low, bottom lane still high

camera.purpose: both schedules on one ruler so the difference in pecking is read directly

required: pecks low where pellets are every time
